findings.title: M365 webhook secret is dead config while the real M365 auth value is undocumented and undeployed
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: no M365_WEBHOOK_SECRET remains (only explanatory comments env.ts:102-105); M365_CLIENT_STATE documented (apps/api/.env.example:40-42), delivered by deploy (printf + envs list) and read by compose (:111).

findings.title: Deploy pipeline does not write several secret-class env vars the API schema and compose reference
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: deploy-do printf block (:759-816) writes every secret-class key incl. TURNSTILE/METRICS/VAPID/MALWARE/ALERTMANAGER/M365_CLIENT_STATE; the envs list forwards them; scripts/check-env-parity.mjs (wired unit-tests action.yml:99-100) runs clean.

findings.title: Rotation and emergency procedures target the wrong GitHub environment for the prod deploy and backup workflows
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: SECRETS_ROTATION.md consuming-environment table (:28-37) + standard/emergency procedures target prod-approval for prod mutations, dev for backups, prod only for read-only plan/resolve jobs (:329-357, :374-383). (Previously partially-fixed.)

findings.title: Secret rotation inventory and GitHub matrix lag the schema/compose; seven keys uncovered
findings.note: at 6b7aa1a the GitHub matrix covers the compose keys, but the rotation inventory (docs/SECRETS_ROTATION.md, 60 rows) still omits secret-class REDIS_PASSWORD, VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY and MALWARE_SCANNER_API_KEY (grep: absent from SECRETS_ROTATION.md and SECRET_ROTATION_RUNBOOK.md).

findings.title: Rotation reminder workflow referenced in docs does not exist; rotation log shows no real rotation
findings.note: at 6b7aa1a secret-rotation-reminder.yml exists (quarterly deduplicated issue); the Rotation Log still holds only the initial-deployment row and the 2026-10-12 dry-run (docs/SECRETS_ROTATION.md:500-505) - no real rotation has been recorded.

findings.title: Secret scanning is diff-scoped only; no full-history scan artifact
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: secret-history-scan.yml (full-history gitleaks 8.30.1 checksum-verified, artifact, loud failure notifier).

findings.title: Produced Terraform `prod.tfvars` is tracked despite `.gitignore` intending to exclude it
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: only env/*.tfvars.example tracked; ignore rules cover env/ and module-root tfvars (.gitignore:58,63).

findings.title: Workflow-scope PAT SCHEDULE_DISPATCH_TOKEN omitted from secret inventory and rotation policy
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: SCHEDULE_DISPATCH_TOKEN is documented as retired (docs/GITHUB_SECRETS_AND_VARIABLES_MATRIX.md:160-162; docs/SECRETS_ROTATION.md:98) and backup-staleness-check.yml:52 uses only secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN; the backup-dispatch workflow no longer exists.

findings.title: Secrets rotation is documented but has no exercised evidence
findings.note: at 6b7aa1a the dated desk dry-run and quarterly reminder exist, but no live rotation/revocation drill has been exercised; the document itself says a dry-run does not close this row (docs/SECRETS_ROTATION.md:422-432).

findings.title: Incident response points at a secret-rotation runbook that is not in docs/
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: docs/SECRET_ROTATION_RUNBOOK.md exists and is referenced from INCIDENT_RESPONSE.md:74,136 and SECRETS_ROTATION.md.

findings.title: Terraform plan artifacts carry sensitive variable values off the runner
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: no binary plan artifact - only sanitized text (terraform-do.yml:137-158); apply jobs re-plan in-job with TF_VAR_* env (:225-249, :290-313).

findings.title: JWT rotation runbook rotates the API verification copy, not the Supabase signing secret, and references a nonexistent JWT_EXPIRY
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: docs/JWT_ROTATION.md rotates the Supabase signing secret first with the API verification copy as a zero-downtime list (SECRETS_ROTATION.md:220-240, :374-380); no JWT_EXPIRY reference.

findings.title: Web runtime validator can silently fall back to a localhost API URL
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: apps/web/Dockerfile:28-30 fails the build when NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is absent, and apps/web/lib/env.ts:87-92 throws in production instead of falling back to localhost; the deploy path still passes it.

findings.title: No IT-level break-glass / emergency credential revocation runbook, and no revocation drill evidence
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: docs/SECRET_ROTATION_RUNBOOK.md covers per-credential revocation points, break-glass paths, escrow and a drill record (desk dry-run 2026-10-12); the live drill remains listed as operator-gated in the record.

findings.title: Secret rotation policy has no evidence any secret was ever rotated
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: the policy now records the honest evidence state (SECRETS_ROTATION.md:421-431) + a dated dry-run row + automated quarterly reminder; no production rotation has occurred (operator action, tracked by SECRET-P2-006).

findings.title: No automated `.env.example` <-> runtime schema <-> docs parity check
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: scripts/check-env-parity.mjs --self-test + run wired in unit-tests action.yml:76-84; runs clean locally ('environment parity OK').

findings.title: NEW: rotation environment table omits the prod backup targets (prod-approval/prod-backup)
findings.note: NEW at 6b7aa1a: docs/SECRETS_ROTATION.md:33 still says the backup/restore/staleness workflows are '— (dev only)' and attach only dev; since DR-P2-009 they attach prod-approval for a prod dispatch and prod-backup for a scheduled prod run (db-backup.yml:48, db-restore-test.yml:45, storage-backup.yml:51, storage-restore-test.yml:54). Following the rotation table would set/rotate prod backup secrets on dev, a silent no-op; the matrix already documents prod-backup (docs/GITHUB_SECRETS_AND_VARIABLES_MATRIX.md:202-204).
